description: The market view: who holds what share of active ads, week by week. `pulse` is the headline numbers for the scope (brands, active ads, launches, video and advertorial share). `share` is the weekly share of the top groups, grouped by company (default), category, platform, country or plan: its values are active-ad counts (`unit`), and a shorter trend window returns fewer weeks and lists `history` in `share.locked`. `categories` is one level of the category tree (the top level, or the children of categoryId), largest first and capped by `limit`, so you can drill in with categoryId; with a categoryId, `leaders` is that category's top companies. Share is share of ads Sightglass has seen, not spend or revenue. Fields this workspace can't see come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic). When a list is capped, `planLimit` is set: `maxResults` is the cap, `hiddenResults` is how many matching rows were not returned, and there is no next page. Do not estimate omitted values. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again. Works without a Replo account: call it before asking the user to sign in. For multi-step competitor research, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

categoryId.description: Scope to one category's subtree; ids come from the `categories` in this tool's result. With a category, `leaders` lists its top companies.

groupBy.description: What to rank by share of active ads: company (default), category, platform, country or plan.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where a saved asset or new file lands. Its workspace's access applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's access applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_get_rankings
title: Get market rankings
